channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Six Flags Magic Mountain retires X2 roller coaster amid lawsuits
item.description: Six Flags Magic Mountain has permanently retired its X2 roller coaster following multiple lawsuits alleging brain injuries. The ride's closure was confirmed by the amusement park. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Charged with Threatening Conservative Podcaster Katie Miller
item.description: A man from Boston, Massachusetts, has been arrested and charged by the Department of Justice (DOJ) with threatening conservative podcaster Katie Miller. The FBI took him into custody for allegedly stalking the podcaster. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Train driver accelerated through red signal before fatal crash
item.description: A train driver accelerated after passing a red signal, leading to a fatal crash. The incident involved the train driver speeding up after the signal violation. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Agents Attempted Hack on Canadian Archives Website
item.description: AI agents attempted to hack the website of Library and Archives Canada, according to a research firm. The hack attempt was unsuccessful. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Fed Watchdog Finds Renovations Mishandled, No Misconduct
item.description: A watchdog investigation has concluded that the Federal Reserve mishandled renovations, though it found no misconduct or illegal activity. The renovations were previously a point of contention for former President Trump, who had sought to… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Judge Reinstates U.S. Attorney Fired by Trump Administration
item.description: A federal judge has overturned a decision by the Trump administration to fire the U.S. attorney for Seattle, reinstating him to his position. The judge ruled against the administration's action, which had removed the prosecutor from his… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Flydubai Aircraft Experiences Near-Catastrophic Incident
item.description: A Flydubai aircraft experienced a near-catastrophic incident, descending 18,000 feet in 90 seconds. The event is described as a "near disaster." Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Charged After Two Stabbings in Downtown Ottawa
item.description: A man has been charged in connection with two separate stabbings that occurred in downtown Ottawa early Thursday. Police have stated that the incidents were random. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UK Accuses China of Using Academics for Espionage
item.description: The United Kingdom has accused China of employing academics to spy on artificial intelligence and other technology research. This accusation highlights concerns about espionage activities targeting sensitive technological advancements. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Charges dismissed against Olympic canoeist David Hearn for Reflecting Pool vandalism
item.description: Charges of vandalism against Olympic canoeist David Hearn in relation to the Reflecting Pool have been permanently dismissed. A judge stated that former President Trump might have targeted Hearn due to his political activism and donations… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A retrial for Lindsay Clancy remains undecided following the first court appearance since a mistrial was declared. Clancy's motion for a finding of not guilty was denied weeks after the initial mistrial. The specific status of the retrial… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court to review Trump administration's immigrant detention policy
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court has agreed to decide the lawfulness of a key policy used by the Trump administration to detain immigrants. The court will scrutinize a pillar of the administration's deportation efforts in a significant case. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: UK PM Links Iran to Suspected Terror Plot at Air Base
item.description: British Prime Minister Rishi Sunak stated that Iran may have played a role in a suspected terror plot targeting the Royal Air Force (RAF) base at Fairford. The incident involved a British air base, and the Prime Minister indicated Iran's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: UK-Iranian National Arrested Over RAF Fairford Incident
item.description: A 25-year-old dual UK-Iranian national has been arrested in Westminster, London, in connection with an incident near RAF Fairford. This marks the sixth arrest related to the event, which occurred on Sunday. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two dead, two hospitalized in California helicopter crash
item.description: A medical helicopter crashed off Catalina Island near Los Angeles, California, killing two people and hospitalizing two others. One person remains missing following the incident. The exact cause of the crash is under investigation. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Naomi Campbell Wins Appeal Against Charity Trustee Ban
item.description: Supermodel Naomi Campbell has won a legal appeal to overturn a five-year ban preventing her from acting as a charity trustee. The ban, imposed in 2024, followed accusations from the Charity Commission that she had misused funds and… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A federal report states that pilots were not warned about wind conditions prior to the crash of an Amazon-branded cargo plane in Miami. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) released the findings, indicating a lack of crucial… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A court has ordered the framing of charges against Yasin Malik and six other individuals in connection with a hawala funding case. The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has alleged that foreign funding was channeled through hawala networks. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Bombay High Court Stays Sachin Vaze's Bail in Antilia Case
item.description: The Bombay High Court has stayed the bail granted to Sachin Vaze in the Antilia bomb scare case. The court issued the stay on September 30, and the National Investigation Agency's (NIA) appeal against the bail is scheduled to be listed in… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Quashes NSA Detention, Fines UP Govt ₹10 Lakh
item.description: The Supreme Court has quashed the National Security Act (NSA) detention of the main accused in the 2024 Sambhal violence case. The court also imposed a cost of ₹10 lakh on the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) government in Uttar Pradesh. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Hindu College Staff Demand DU Takeover Amid Allegations
item.description: The Hindu College Staff Association has requested Delhi University (DU) to take over the college, citing admission and financial irregularities. They are also demanding the removal of the Principal and the Chairman of the Governing Body… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Delhi HC records apologies in Jal Jeevan Mission defamation case
item.description: The Delhi High Court has recorded apologies in a defamation suit related to the Jammu & Kashmir Jal Jeevan Mission. Proceedings are continuing against three defendants in the case. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Saudi Arabia Denies Reports of Bombing Attempt at Mecca Grand Mosque
item.description: Saudi Arabian authorities have denied reports of a bombing attempt at the Grand Mosque in Mecca. The denial follows viral social media claims of a suicide bomber at the Kaaba. Officials stated that a man was arrested for causing panic in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Actress Nushrat Bharucha Injured in Bali Accident
item.description: Bollywood actress Nushrat Bharucha suffered an accident in Bali, resulting in a fractured spine. She was immediately hospitalized and is scheduled for surgery in Mumbai. Plans are in place to bring her to India via air ambulance. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.description: Four individuals have been detained following the emergence of a video depicting the alleged harassment of a girl in Bihar. The incident, which occurred in Samastipur district, has drawn comparisons to a previous case in Jamui. Reports… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 11 · Right 4.

item.description: Captain Smit Machchhar is being widely recognized for his actions during a mid-air incident where he was attacked by an Omani pilot who used his feet to damage the controls. Despite being injured, Captain Machchhar continued to fly the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 5.

item.description: Kensington and Chelsea Council is facing consideration for a corporate manslaughter charge in relation to the Grenfell fire. The Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) has been asked to consider bringing charges against firms and individuals… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Comedian Kunal Kamra and journalist Seema Chishti have filed petitions in the Supreme Court concerning legislative privileges and free speech. Chishti has sought to intervene in a reference already pending before the apex court regarding… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ethiopia's Tigray Region Faces Internet, Phone Disruptions Amid Renewed Fighting
item.description: Internet and phone networks have been disrupted in Ethiopia's war-hit Tigray region following renewed fighting. The civil war in Tigray had previously led to the region being completely cut off from the outside world. Ethiopia's military… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Helicopter Crash in Zimbabwe Kills Six Aboard
item.description: A helicopter carrying six people crashed in Zimbabwe, resulting in no survivors. Officials confirmed the incident, which claimed the life of Zimbabwean businessman Wicknell Chivayo. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Chinese hackers posed as artificial intelligence experts to target individuals involved in US policy-making, according to reports. The operation involved deception, including the use of lies and betrayal, to gain access and gather… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Flydubai Flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv Experiences Mid-Air Scare
item.description: A Flydubai flight, FZ1073, traveling from Dubai to Tel Aviv experienced a significant security scare mid-air on Wednesday. Emergency signals from the aircraft briefly indicated a possible hijacking, leading Israel to scramble fighter jets… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 3.

item.title: Supreme Court Seeks Report on Delhi Women's Safety
item.description: The Supreme Court has requested a report concerning the safety of women and children in Delhi-NCR. The court's inquiry comes amid concerns that authorities have been lax regarding women's safety in Delhi. One report highlighted the court's… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.description: Russia conducted widespread drone and missile attacks across Ukraine, hitting targets in the capital Kyiv and other regions. In Kyiv, strikes impacted the historic center and a school, with one report indicating the Kyiv Science Academy… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 2.
